name: Restaurant Reservations
title: Table reservations
ask: Do you have a table for four on Friday at 7pm?
covers: tables and party sizes, opening hours, menus, dietary options and private dining
rule: Never confirm a table: the restaurant confirms every reservation. Never take a deposit or card details in the chat.
who: Sit-down restaurants that take table bookings and want them separate from takeaway orders: the existing Restaurants & Food Service plug-in is for orders.
author: Bart Cant

page.headline: Table requests that arrive ready to confirm
page.problem: A host seating a full room cannot pick up the phone, and a guest who gets no answer books somewhere else. A plug-in shows your table sizes and the times you take bookings, answers the questions guests ask first, and sends the reservation request to your team to confirm.
valueProps: Tables by party size::The table sizes you publish, with how long a sitting lasts.
Times you take bookings::Times within your published opening hours, one sitting apart.
Requests to your host::Table, day, time and notes arrive ready to confirm.
moments: Friday at 7pm::A table for four requested during the dinner rush.
The vegetarian guest::Your published dietary options, answered before they book.
The birthday dinner::A private dining request sent to your team.
Is my table confirmed?::A reference check instead of a call.
faqs: Is the table confirmed in the chat?::No. Your team confirms every reservation. The times come from your published hours, not a live reservation system.
Does it take deposits?::No. It never takes a deposit or card details. Your team arranges those when confirming.

chat.confirm: 7pm, and one of us is vegetarian.
chat.sent: Table for 4 · Fri 19:00 · Note: one vegetarian guest
